title: Prove the uniform 3t cyclic inverse-Q8 tariff
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact homogeneous cyclic inverse-generator tariff 3t for every positive integer t, with arbitrary finite restored dirty workspace. Every paid label is the same positive generator g=i, or the same g=j. This closes PR3551's timed-out cyclic handoff.

```text
full ordered cubic equations
  X0Y0=I, X0 K Y0=X0 K²Y0=0, K invertible
  KU and K²U are disjoint t-dimensional subspaces of ker X0
  2t <= n-t, so n>=3t
  three calls per target attain the bound for every t
```

A separate lemma proves every quadratically correct n=2t word has a compressed cubic defect of rank t. The initial four-target hypothesis/history and exact predecessor proof/witness bytes are preserved. Mixed i/j minima, a physical caller, complete supplier and new kappa remain unclaimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3551 attains the complete degree-two relaxation and leaves its full cyclic probe unknown. **After:** the written subspace proof gives the sharp cyclic tariff for all t, without another solver search or enlarged census.
- The unchanged bounded experiment checks 4,104 small block matrices, 3,120 short labeled words on 49,840 formal input columns, the retained false positive, 24 attaining dirty endpoints and 180 omissions. Five optimized behavioral groups test actual arithmetic/action/rank faults and boundary failures. The universal quantifier is proved in PROOF.md.
- At publication commit `00a1f0ff7284f98e25808c1566349a85c5963dae`, CPython3.12 registered replay and `scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/q8-cyclic-cubic-obstruction --check-source-history` pass. Scoped Ruff E/F/B/UP passes. Both actual committed Git-free commands pass, with all 14 exported payload files preserving their bytes and identities.
- [Canonical investigation and original hypothesis](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2034#discussioncomment-19012351). PR3536 retains the half-call bound, PR3517 the ordered Gram/core lineage and PR3551 the saturated witness. Full selected replay, mixed-label minima, human/formal acceptance and all physical supplier obligations remain unrun or unresolved.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds only `research/q8-cyclic-cubic-obstruction/`. Frozen inputs and the selected result are unchanged.
